R1-2409182	Summary of QCL relationship of SSBs transmitted with the same block index	Moderator (ZTE)
From Wednesday session
Conclusion

It is RAN1 understanding that the UE assumes that SSBs transmitted with the same block index and associated with different physical cell id on the same center frequency location are NOT quasi co-located with respect to Doppler spread, Doppler shift, average gain, average delay, delay spread, and, when applicable, spatial Rx parameters.
